name: Keycloak Detection Suite
summary: Logins, failed logins, brute-force lockouts, credential changes, stolen tokens and authorization codes, and administrator changes from the Keycloak event log, which Wazuh does not decode at all.
summary_zh: Keycloak 事件記錄中的登入、登入失敗、暴力破解鎖定、憑證變更、被竊的 token 與授權碼，以及管理者變更；Wazuh 內建完全不解碼。
notes: Wazuh has no decoder or rule for Keycloak. Keycloak reports every login, failed login and administrator change through its jboss-logging event listener, one key=value line per event (logger org.keycloak.events). The pack decodes realm, client, user, source address (srcip), error and, for admin events, the operation, resource type and resource path.

Successful events are logged at DEBUG unless the site raises them, so out of the box only failures arrive. Set KC_SPI_EVENTS_LISTENER__JBOSS_LOGGING__SUCCESS_LEVEL=info to see logins and admin changes. The realm's event storage settings (eventsEnabled, enabledEventTypes) do not matter here: the log listener receives every event type.

Logins: a successful login is not an alert. From a private address (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, fc00::/7, fe80::/10) it is recorded at level 2 and alerts at level 3 only the first time that user signs in from that address (FTS on user and address), so a script or monitoring probe that logs in every few minutes alerts once per address, ever. The admin console (client security-admin-console, any realm) is level 3 every time from a private address; any other master realm login (kcadm, the admin REST API) follows the first-time rule. From a public address an ordinary login is level 5, an admin console or master realm login level 8. A successful login after five failures in 10 minutes is level 12 from the address that failed, level 10 for the account that failed from other addresses. Logouts (level 2) and the token requests that follow every login (level 0) do not alert.

Nothing has to be listed for that. etc/lists/jt-keycloak-service-accounts is optional tuning: a listed account's first-time and public-address logins stay at level 2 as well. Admin console logins and failures are never affected. IPv6 unique-local (fc00::/7) and link-local (fe80::/10) sources count as private. The IPv6 loopback cannot be checked as a network (on Wazuh 4.14.7 ::1 in a rule's srcip matches every IPv4 address), so it is recognised by its text and recorded at level 2 without the first-time check; public IPv6 sources alert like public IPv4 ones.

Failures: a wrong password, an unknown user and a disabled account are level 5, a wrong client secret level 6, an attempt on an account that brute-force protection has locked level 10. In the master realm or at an admin console (Keycloak's built-in names only) a wrong password or an unknown user is level 8. A wrong one-time code after the correct password is level 6, level 8 for an admin-class account: Keycloak sets selected_credential_id only in the one-time code form, so that event proves the password was right; three for one account within 10 minutes are level 10. Eight failures from one address within five minutes are level 10; six different unknown user names from one address within 10 minutes are level 8 (account enumeration). Keycloak's own lockout event is level 10, level 12 when the account is disabled permanently, and level 12 when three accounts are locked from one address within 10 minutes (password spraying, or lockouts used as denial of service). A missing session cookie, an expired page, the back button after a login and a session that ended are level 2: every real user produces them.

Credentials and accounts: a password or one-time code set is level 5, level 8 from a public address (how an account takeover such as CVE-2026-18963 ends), and removed level 8; an e-mail address changed or an account deleted level 5; a client registered through dynamic client registration level 8; an administrator impersonating a user level 10; a client exchanging a token for another user (legacy token exchange with requested_subject) level 8. Keycloak 24 to 26 report a change under the deprecated names UPDATE_PASSWORD, UPDATE_TOTP and REMOVE_TOTP, and Keycloak 26 adds UPDATE_CREDENTIAL or REMOVE_CREDENTIAL for the same change in the same millisecond. The deprecated event alerts; its twin, the new event for the same user within 10 seconds, stays at level 2. A new event without a twin (Keycloak 27, WebAuthn, recovery codes) alerts. So every change alerts once, on every version.

Admin events: a role granted, realm settings, event logging settings, authentication flows, identity providers, a client secret and a deleted federation or key component are level 10; a deleted realm level 12; scope mappings, roles, group membership, required actions and their configuration, federation and component changes, clients created or deleted, and an administrator setting or removing a user's credential level 8 (removal is written as ACTION; 1.1 waited for DELETE and never fired); the rest level 3 to 6. Keycloak names the realm the administrator signed in to (usually master) and the administrator's user id, not a user name and not the realm that was changed: the resource path in the alert says what changed. A failed admin operation writes no admin event.

Server: start and stop are level 3; the start of a version affected by CVE-2026-18963 (critical, unauthenticated account takeover through the reset-credentials flow: 26.0.0 to 26.4.14, 26.5.0 to 26.6.5, 26.7.0 to 26.7.1) is level 10 instead and names the fixed versions. An authorization code presented a second time (Keycloak's code parser) is level 8, a code put together with another session level 10. An uncaught server error is level 5, any other ERROR line (LDAP, database, mail) level 4. An uncaught WebApplicationException is an HTTP status a request handler raised on purpose; on the site this pack was built on, all 88 in 13 days were the welcome page answering requests that had no Host header, three at a time every six hours, so they are level 2. Stack trace lines, 90 per cent of the log there, are decoded and dropped.

Collection: the recommended way is the docker journald logging driver with the tag keycloak (or Keycloak under systemd), because the agent already reads the journal. The Keycloak log file and the docker json-file log work too. The json-file log is matched on its log field only, without decoded fields: no first-time logins, no correlation by address, no active response and a smaller rule set (131330-131339, 131346-131347); its logins follow the same levels by address. Keycloak's JSON console format (log-console-output=json) is not supported. The detections added in 1.2 (one-time codes, tokens and codes, redirect URIs, enumeration, lockouts of several accounts, vulnerable version) need the journal or the log file.

Measured on one site (Keycloak 26.4.7, one realm behind a reverse proxy, 13 days of log, 7,150 lines replayed through the rules): 159 alerts at level 3 or higher with 1.2, the same number as with 1.1 (1.0: 278). The 39 one-time code enrolments now alert under their deprecated name UPDATE_TOTP while the UPDATE_CREDENTIAL twin is only recorded, and the start of 26.4.7 alerts as a vulnerable version. None of the new token, code, redirect, one-time code, enumeration or lockout rules fired on that data. Logins are a small part: four admin console logins, one from a public address, the first-time (user, address) pairs, and three level 12 alerts where a test suite signed in from the address that had just tried an unknown user 19 times. The rest are the setup day's admin changes and failed user deletions. The 6,450 stack trace lines and 88 routine HTTP errors raised none. No wrong-password, wrong-code, token or lockout event occurred in that time; those rules are tested with lines built from the Keycloak 26.4.7 source.

Tokens and codes: at the token endpoint an authorization code with another redirect_uri, from another client or with a failed PKCE check is level 8 (an intercepted code, or a misconfigured client); a refresh token presented again after it was used is level 10, and a refresh token of one client presented by another level 8: both mean a stolen token. At the authorization endpoint a refused redirect_uri is level 5 (usually an application moved to a new address) and level 10 when it is built to fool URI validation: traversal, "..;", a backslash, a user part or an encoded separator in the host, an encoded control character. That is the shape of the redirect_uri validation bypasses CVE-2023-6291, CVE-2024-1132, CVE-2024-2419, CVE-2024-8883, CVE-2026-3872 and CVE-2026-7504.

Versions: written for Keycloak 26.4.7 and checked against the 24.0.5 and 26.4.7 sources of the event listener. Keycloak 25 and later write realmName; 24 and older do not, and the realmId stands in for it: the admin console is still recognised by its client, the master realm only where its id is "master" (installations created by older releases). Values are quoted by default; values that can contain commas (reason, redirect_uri) are read to their closing quote, and the pack also works with quotes set to none.

Realm settings some rules need: brute-force detection is off by default, and Keycloak then never locks accounts, so 131318, 131319, 131343 and 131365 stay silent (every other failure rule works without it); a used refresh token can be used again unless Revoke Refresh Token is on, which 131359 needs. See the setup guide. Clearing the stored events, a partial export of a realm (client secrets included) and failed admin operations write no admin event, so no rule can see them.

Cross-pack login groups (patch release): jt_auth_success on 131310, 131311, 131312, 131313, 131325, 131327, 131328, 131329; jt_auth_failure on 131341, 131342, 131344, 131349, 131353; jt_auth_lockout on 131343. They let jt-account-guard correlate logins across services and jt-ioc look up the address of every tagged successful login; levels and matching are unchanged, and without those packs the groups do nothing. Not tagged: the docker json-file shape (131331-131334, 131346, 131347: no address or account is decoded), one-time code and client secret failures (131348, 131355, 131351), lockout events that name a user id only (131318, 131319).
notes_zh: Wazuh 對 Keycloak 沒有任何解碼器或規則。Keycloak 透過 jboss-logging 事件監聽器回報每一次登入、登入失敗與管理者變更，一個事件一行 key=value（logger 為 org.keycloak.events）。本套件解出 realm、client、使用者、來源位址（srcip）、錯誤，以及管理事件的操作、資源類型與資源路徑。
成功事件預設以 DEBUG 記錄，所以不調整的話只會收到失敗事件。設定 KC_SPI_EVENTS_LISTENER__JBOSS_LOGGING__SUCCESS_LEVEL=info 才看得到登入與管理變更。realm 的事件儲存設定（eventsEnabled、enabledEventTypes）在這裡沒有影響：記錄監聽器會收到所有事件類型。

登入：成功登入不是告警。來自私有位址（10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、fc00::/7、fe80::/10）的登入記錄為 level 2，只有該使用者第一次從該位址登入時才以 level 3 告警（以使用者與位址做 FTS），所以每幾分鐘登入一次的腳本或監控探針，每個位址只會告警一次。管理主控台（client security-admin-console，任何 realm）從私有位址登入每次都是 level 3；其他 master realm 登入（kcadm、管理 REST API）適用第一次登入的規則。來自公開位址時，一般登入為 level 5，管理主控台或 master realm 登入為 level 8。10 分鐘內失敗五次後登入成功：同一來源位址為 level 12，同一帳號但來自其他位址為 level 10。登出（level 2）與每次登入之後的 token 請求（level 0）不告警。

以上都不需要列出任何帳號。etc/lists/jt-keycloak-service-accounts 只是選用的調校：列入的帳號第一次登入與從公開位址登入也維持在 level 2。管理主控台登入與失敗事件永遠不受影響。IPv6 的 unique-local（fc00::/7）與 link-local（fe80::/10）來源視為私有。IPv6 loopback 無法以網段判斷（在 Wazuh 4.14.7，規則 srcip 中的 ::1 會符合所有 IPv4 位址），所以改以位址文字辨識，記錄為 level 2，不做第一次登入的判斷；公開 IPv6 來源與公開 IPv4 一樣告警。

失敗：密碼錯誤、使用者不存在、帳號已停用為 level 5，client secret 錯誤為 level 6，嘗試登入已被暴力破解防護鎖定的帳號為 level 10。在 master realm 或管理主控台（只依 Keycloak 內建名稱判斷）密碼錯誤或使用者不存在為 level 8。密碼正確之後一次性密碼錯誤為 level 6，管理類帳號為 level 8：Keycloak 只在一次性密碼表單設定 selected_credential_id，所以這個事件證明密碼是對的；同一帳號 10 分鐘內三次為 level 10。同一位址五分鐘內八次失敗為 level 10；同一位址 10 分鐘內嘗試六個不同的不存在使用者名稱為 level 8（帳號列舉）。Keycloak 自己的鎖定事件為 level 10，永久停用帳號為 level 12，同一位址 10 分鐘內鎖定三個帳號也是 level 12（密碼噴灑，或利用鎖定造成服務阻斷）。缺少 session cookie、頁面逾時、登入後按上一頁、session 已結束為 level 2：每個真實使用者都會產生。

憑證與帳號：設定密碼或一次性密碼為 level 5，從公開位址設定為 level 8（CVE-2026-18963 這類帳號接管的最後一步就是它），移除為 level 8；變更電子郵件或刪除帳號為 level 5；透過動態 client 註冊建立 client 為 level 8；管理者模擬（impersonate）使用者為 level 10；client 以 token 交換取得其他使用者的 token（舊版 token exchange 帶 requested_subject）為 level 8。Keycloak 24 到 26 以已棄用的名稱 UPDATE_PASSWORD、UPDATE_TOTP、REMOVE_TOTP 回報變更，Keycloak 26 另在同一毫秒為同一變更寫出 UPDATE_CREDENTIAL 或 REMOVE_CREDENTIAL。已棄用的事件告警；它的分身（10 秒內同一使用者的新事件）維持在 level 2。沒有分身的新事件（Keycloak 27、WebAuthn、復原碼）會告警。因此每個版本上每次變更都只告警一次。

管理事件：授予角色、realm 設定、事件記錄設定、驗證流程、身分提供者、client secret、刪除 federation 或金鑰元件為 level 10；刪除 realm 為 level 12；scope mapping、角色、群組成員、必要動作與其設定、federation 與元件變更、建立或刪除 client、管理者設定或移除使用者的憑證為 level 8（移除寫成 ACTION；1.1 版等的是 DELETE，從未觸發）；其餘為 level 3 到 6。Keycloak 記的是管理者登入的 realm（通常是 master）與管理者的使用者 ID，不是使用者名稱，也不是被變更的 realm：告警中的資源路徑才說明改了什麼。失敗的管理操作不會寫出管理事件。

伺服器：啟動與停止為 level 3；受 CVE-2026-18963 影響的版本（重大，透過重設密碼流程免驗證接管帳號：26.0.0 到 26.4.14、26.5.0 到 26.6.5、26.7.0 到 26.7.1）啟動時改為 level 10，並列出已修正的版本。授權碼被第二次提交（Keycloak 的授權碼解析器）為 level 8，與其他 session 拼湊出的授權碼為 level 10。未處理的伺服器錯誤為 level 5，其他 ERROR 行（LDAP、資料庫、郵件）為 level 4。未處理的 WebApplicationException 是請求處理程式刻意回應的 HTTP 狀態；在建置本套件的站台上，13 天內 88 筆全是歡迎頁回應沒有 Host 標頭的請求，每六小時三筆，因此為 level 2。stack trace 的各行（當地記錄的 90%）會被解碼後丟棄。

收集方式：建議使用 docker 的 journald 記錄驅動程式並設定 tag 為 keycloak（或以 systemd 執行 Keycloak），因為 agent 本來就有讀 journal。Keycloak 記錄檔與 docker json-file 記錄也可以。json-file 記錄只比對其 log 欄位、沒有解碼欄位：沒有第一次登入判斷、無法依位址關聯、不能用主動回應，規則也較少（131330-131339、131346-131347）；其登入同樣依位址分級。不支援 Keycloak 的 JSON 主控台格式（log-console-output=json）。1.2 版新增的偵測（一次性密碼、token 與授權碼、redirect URI、帳號列舉、多個帳號被鎖定、有弱點的版本）需要 journal 或記錄檔。

單一站台實測（Keycloak 26.4.7，一個 realm，位於反向代理之後，13 天、7,150 行記錄重新送過規則）：1.2 版共 159 則 level 3 以上的告警，與 1.1 版相同（1.0 版為 278 則）。39 次一次性密碼註冊改以已棄用的名稱 UPDATE_TOTP 告警，UPDATE_CREDENTIAL 分身只記錄；26.4.7 的啟動則以有弱點的版本告警。新增的 token、授權碼、redirect、一次性密碼、帳號列舉與鎖定規則在這份資料上都沒有觸發。登入只佔一小部分：四次管理主控台登入、一次來自公開位址、第一次出現的（使用者、位址），以及三則 level 12：測試套件剛用不存在的使用者嘗試 19 次，又從同一位址登入。其餘是設定當天的管理變更與刪除使用者失敗。6,450 行 stack trace 與 88 筆例行 HTTP 錯誤都沒有告警。期間沒有發生密碼錯誤、一次性密碼錯誤、token 或鎖定事件；這些規則以依 Keycloak 26.4.7 原始碼組出的記錄行測試。

Token 與授權碼：在 token 端點，授權碼的 redirect_uri 不同、來自其他 client 或 PKCE 檢查失敗為 level 8（授權碼被攔截，或 client 設定錯誤）；已用過的 refresh token 再次被提交為 level 10，某個 client 的 refresh token 由其他 client 提交為 level 8：兩者都表示 token 被竊。在授權端點，redirect_uri 被拒為 level 5（通常是應用程式搬到新網址），刻意構造來騙過 URI 驗證時為 level 10：路徑跳脫、「..;」、反斜線、主機部分帶使用者資訊或編碼過的分隔字元、編碼過的控制字元。這正是 CVE-2023-6291、CVE-2024-1132、CVE-2024-2419、CVE-2024-8883、CVE-2026-3872、CVE-2026-7504 這些 redirect_uri 驗證繞過的樣子。

版本：依 Keycloak 26.4.7 撰寫，並對照事件監聽器 24.0.5 與 26.4.7 的原始碼。Keycloak 25 以後會寫 realmName，24 以前沒有，改以 realmId 代替：管理主控台仍可依其 client 辨識，master realm 則只在其 ID 為「master」時（較舊版本建立的安裝）才認得出來。值預設加引號；可能含逗號的值（reason、redirect_uri）會讀到結尾的引號為止；quotes 設為 none 時本套件同樣可用。

部分規則需要的 realm 設定：暴力破解偵測預設關閉，此時 Keycloak 從不鎖定帳號，131318、131319、131343、131365 都不會觸發（其他失敗規則不需要它）；未開啟 Revoke Refresh Token 時，用過的 refresh token 可以再用，131359 需要它。請見部署說明。清除已儲存的事件、realm 的部分匯出（含 client secret）與失敗的管理操作都不會寫出管理事件，任何規則都看不到。

跨套件登入群組（修補版）：jt_auth_success：131310, 131311, 131312, 131313, 131325, 131327, 131328, 131329；jt_auth_failure：131341, 131342, 131344, 131349, 131353；jt_auth_lockout：131343。讓 jt-account-guard 跨服務關聯登入、jt-ioc 查詢每一筆加標記的成功登入來源位址；等級與比對條件不變，沒有安裝這些套件時群組沒有作用。未加標記：docker json-file 形狀（131331-131334、131346、131347，解不出位址與帳號）、一次性密碼與用戶端密鑰失敗（131348、131355、131351）、只有使用者 ID 的鎖定事件（131318、131319）。
author: Jason Tools

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並重新載入規則集
setup.body:
1. Install the pack from this page.
2. On the Rules tab, press Reload Ruleset. It reloads every cluster node; the cluster copies rule files to the workers but does not reload them.
setup.body_zh:
1. 在本頁安裝套件。
2. 到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」，所有叢集節點都會重新載入；叢集會把規則檔複製到 worker，但不會替它們重新載入。
setup.verify: /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t on the manager prints no error or warning.
setup.verify_zh: 在 manager 上執行 /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t，沒有任何錯誤或警告。

setup.title: Make Keycloak log successful events
setup.title_zh: 讓 Keycloak 記錄成功事件
setup.body:
1. Add the variable below to the Keycloak container, or the option to kc.sh start. Older releases spell the variable with single underscores: KC_SPI_EVENTS_LISTENER_JBOSS_LOGGING_SUCCESS_LEVEL.
2. Restart Keycloak (sign-in is down for a moment).
Without this, logins and admin changes are logged at DEBUG and only failures reach Wazuh.
setup.body_zh:
1. 在 Keycloak 容器加上下方的環境變數，或在 kc.sh start 加上選項。較舊的版本變數寫成單底線：KC_SPI_EVENTS_LISTENER_JBOSS_LOGGING_SUCCESS_LEVEL。
2. 重新啟動 Keycloak（登入服務會短暫中斷）。
沒有這一步，登入與管理變更以 DEBUG 記錄，送到 Wazuh 的只有失敗事件。
setup.code:
# docker compose, service keycloak, environment:
KC_SPI_EVENTS_LISTENER__JBOSS_LOGGING__SUCCESS_LEVEL: info

# or on the command line
kc.sh start --spi-events-listener--jboss-logging--success-level=info
setup.verify: Sign in once, then look for a line with type="LOGIN" in the Keycloak log.
setup.verify_zh: 登入一次，Keycloak 記錄中應出現含 type="LOGIN" 的行。

setup.title: Send the Keycloak log to the journal
setup.title_zh: 把 Keycloak 記錄送進 journal
setup.body:
1. Give the Keycloak service the journald logging driver with tag keycloak (below) and recreate the container (sign-in is down for a moment). docker logs keeps working.
2. Check that the agent's ossec.conf has the journald localfile shown in the code.
3. If rsyslog also copies the journal into a file the agent reads, every line arrives twice: read only one of them.
Keycloak installed on the host under systemd already writes to the journal; it needs only step 2.
setup.body_zh:
1. 替 Keycloak 服務設定 journald 記錄驅動程式、tag 為 keycloak（如下），並重建容器（登入服務會短暫中斷）。docker logs 仍可使用。
2. 確認 agent 的 ossec.conf 有程式碼中那段 journald localfile。
3. 若 rsyslog 也把 journal 複製到 agent 會讀的檔案，每行會收到兩次：只讀其中一個。
直接以 systemd 安裝在主機上的 Keycloak 本來就寫進 journal，只需做第 2 步。
setup.code:
# docker-compose.yml, service keycloak:
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: keycloak

docker compose up -d keycloak
# the agent must have this in ossec.conf:
#   <localfile><log_format>journald</log_format><location>journald</location></localfile>
setup.verify: journalctl -t keycloak -n 5 shows Keycloak lines; a failed login then raises rule 131341 or 131342 (level 5) on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: journalctl -t keycloak -n 5 可看到 Keycloak 的記錄；之後一次登入失敗，manager 端應出現規則 131341 或 131342（level 5）。

setup.title: Behind a reverse proxy: log the client address
setup.title_zh: 位於反向代理之後：記下用戶端位址
setup.body: Set KC_PROXY_HEADERS to the header your proxy sends (xforwarded or forwarded), and make the proxy overwrite, not append to, that header. Otherwise every event carries the proxy's address: the brute-force rules count all users as one source and an active response would block the proxy.
setup.body_zh: 把 KC_PROXY_HEADERS 設為代理實際送出的標頭（xforwarded 或 forwarded），並讓代理覆寫（而不是附加）這個標頭。否則每個事件都是代理的位址：暴力破解規則會把所有使用者算成同一個來源，主動回應則會封鎖代理本身。
setup.code: KC_PROXY_HEADERS: xforwarded    # X-Forwarded-For; use forwarded for the Forwarded header
setup.verify: After a failed login, the alert (131341 or 131342) shows the client's address in srcip, not the proxy's.
setup.verify_zh: 一次登入失敗後，告警（131341 或 131342）的 srcip 是用戶端位址，而不是代理的位址。

setup.title: Optional: turn on brute-force detection and token revocation
setup.title_zh: 選用：開啟暴力破解偵測與 token 撤銷
setup.body:
Both are realm settings, off by default, and need no restart (admin console or the kcadm commands below; <realm> is the realm name).
1. Brute-force detection (Realm settings, Security defenses): without it Keycloak never locks an account and the lockout rules 131318, 131319, 131343 and 131365 stay silent. Anyone who knows a user name can then lock that account.
2. Revoke Refresh Token (Realm settings, Tokens): needed to detect a stolen refresh token (131359). Test your applications first: a client that refreshes twice in parallel gets an error.
setup.body_zh:
兩者都是 realm 設定，預設關閉，不需重新啟動（在管理主控台設定，或用下方的 kcadm 指令；<realm> 是 realm 名稱）。
1. 暴力破解偵測（Realm settings 的 Security defenses）：沒有它 Keycloak 從不鎖定帳號，鎖定規則 131318、131319、131343、131365 不會觸發。開啟後，任何知道使用者名稱的人都能鎖住該帳號。
2. Revoke Refresh Token（Realm settings 的 Tokens）：偵測 refresh token 被竊（131359）需要它。請先測試應用程式：同時重新整理兩次的 client 會收到錯誤。
setup.code:
kcadm.sh update realms/<realm> -s bruteForceProtected=true
kcadm.sh update realms/<realm> -s revokeRefreshToken=true -s refreshTokenMaxReuse=0
setup.verify: kcadm.sh get realms/<realm> --fields bruteForceProtected,revokeRefreshToken prints true for both.
setup.verify_zh: kcadm.sh get realms/<realm> --fields bruteForceProtected,revokeRefreshToken 兩者都顯示 true。

setup.title: Optional: list machine accounts with changing addresses
setup.title_zh: 選用：列出位址不固定的機器帳號
setup.body:
Not needed: a login from a private address alerts only the first time per user and address. List an account only if it signs in from ever-changing or public addresses (a cloud monitor); its first-time and public-address logins then stay at level 2.
Add one user name per line (<user> below), then reload the ruleset.
setup.body_zh:
不是必要的：從私有位址登入，每個使用者與位址只在第一次告警。只有帳號會從不斷變動或公開的位址登入（例如雲端監控）時才列入；之後它第一次登入與從公開位址登入都維持 level 2。
每個使用者名稱一行（下方的 <user>），然後重新載入規則集。

setup.title: Alternative: read the Keycloak log file
setup.title_zh: 替代方式：讀取 Keycloak 記錄檔
setup.body: For Keycloak on the host with file logging (log=file): add the localfile below to the agent's ossec.conf and restart the agent. Do not also read the journal for the same server, or every line arrives twice.
setup.body_zh: 適用於在主機上執行並啟用檔案記錄（log=file）的 Keycloak：把下方的 localfile 加進 agent 的 ossec.conf 並重啟 agent。同一台伺服器不要同時讀 journal，否則每行會收到兩次。

setup.title: Alternative: read the docker json-file log (limited)
setup.title_zh: 替代方式：讀取 docker json-file 記錄（功能有限）
setup.body:
Only if the logging driver cannot be changed: add the localfile below to the agent's ossec.conf.
Only rules 131330-131339 work: there is no source address, so no per-address brute-force rule and no active response, and none of the 1.2 detections. The wildcard reads every container on the host. Set max-size for the containers, because Docker does not rotate this file otherwise.
setup.body_zh:
只在無法更改記錄驅動程式時使用：把下方的 localfile 加進 agent 的 ossec.conf。
只有規則 131330-131339 有作用：沒有來源位址，所以沒有依位址的暴力破解規則、不能用主動回應，1.2 版新增的偵測也都沒有。萬用字元會讀到主機上每個容器的記錄。請替容器設定 max-size，否則 Docker 不會輪替這個檔案。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to sign in to Keycloak, or locks several accounts
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入 Keycloak 失敗、或鎖住多個帳號的位址
active_response.body: Drops traffic from the source address for 10 minutes after rule 131360 (eight failed logins from one address in five minutes) or 131365 (brute-force protection locked three accounts from one address in 10 minutes), using iptables or nftables on the chosen agent. Choose the host where client connections arrive: behind a reverse proxy that is the proxy, not the Keycloak host. Blocking on the Keycloak host behind a proxy does nothing when Keycloak trusts the proxy headers (the client never connects to it directly), and blocks the proxy, and with it every user, when it does not (srcip is then the proxy). Only for a Keycloak reached directly is the Keycloak host itself right. The address is only as good as the proxy: if it appends to an X-Forwarded-For header the client sent instead of overwriting it, the client chooses the address that gets blocked, for example an administrator's. Risk: an administrator who mistypes a password eight times is locked out for 10 minutes, and so is everyone behind the same NAT address, including users who come in through a router's hairpin NAT. Put the proxy, NAT gateways and management networks in the manager's white_list first.
active_response.body_zh: 規則 131360（同一位址五分鐘內登入失敗八次）或 131365（暴力破解防護在 10 分鐘內從同一位址鎖住三個帳號）觸發後，在所選 agent 上以 iptables 或 nftables 封鎖來源位址 10 分鐘。請選用戶端連線實際抵達的主機：位於反向代理之後時是代理，而不是 Keycloak 主機。在代理後方的 Keycloak 主機上封鎖，若 Keycloak 信任代理標頭則毫無作用（用戶端從不直接連它）；若不信任則會封鎖代理本身，連帶所有使用者（此時 srcip 就是代理）。只有用戶端直接連線的 Keycloak，才適合在 Keycloak 主機上封鎖。位址的可信度取決於代理：若代理是附加到用戶端自帶的 X-Forwarded-For 標頭而不是覆寫它，用戶端就能決定哪個位址被封鎖，例如管理者的位址。風險：打錯密碼八次的管理者會被擋 10 分鐘，同一個 NAT 位址後的所有人也一樣，包括經由路由器 hairpin NAT 進來的使用者。請先把代理、NAT 閘道與管理網段加入 manager 的 white_list。
